what: When consolidating or auditing docs, ALWAYS cross-reference ALL related files — not just the primary file being edited. The V1-V22 consolidation into Sessions A-G was correct within the spec, but missed 6 additional scenarios from separate validation docs (INTEGRATION_TESTING.md, RUN_VALIDATION.md) that had never been merged into the spec. Check adjacent docs before claiming completeness.
why: User caught that I claimed everything was captured during consolidation but gaps were found when finally cross-referencing the stale docs. Process gap: consolidating within one file without checking related files.
